Proposition
[Evolution of $H$] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0127 1. Proposition 5.16\group normalized-ricci-flow

On a solution $(\M ^2,g(t))$ of the normalized Ricci flow on a compact surface, the quantity \[ H:=R-r+\Delta f \] evolves by a scalar parabolic inequality that implies a time-dependent upper bound for $R$.
